guides.wedding-video-invitation-maker.ti: Video Wedding Invitations: Length, Sound and Delivery
guides.wedding-video-invitation-maker.de: A video invitation should be short, readable without sound and easy to open on any phone. Here is a practical spec and delivery checklist.
guides.wedding-video-invitation-maker.le: Most guests open an invitation on a phone, often with sound off. Design for the muted, vertical, small-screen case first.
guides.wedding-video-invitation-maker.f1: 20–45 seconds is enough for names, date and venue
guides.wedding-video-invitation-maker.f2: 1080 × 1920 vertical, or square for messaging apps
guides.wedding-video-invitation-maker.f3: Every essential word must appear as on-screen text
guides.wedding-video-invitation-maker.f4: A link plus a static image fallback for every guest
guides.wedding-video-invitation-maker.s1: Open with the names and the date in the first three seconds, then the venue and one or two personal frames, then a clear closing card with the RSVP link. Burn in captions rather than relying on auto-captions, and keep type large enough to read on a phone held at arm's length. Export a compressed MP4 that plays inline rather than forcing a download.
guides.wedding-video-invitation-maker.s2: Video invitations are popular for South Asian, Middle Eastern and Southeast Asian weddings, where a multi-event celebration may need a longer sequence with separate cards for each function. For a Western formal invitation, some older guests still expect paper — send both rather than making the video the only channel. Check file-size limits on the messaging apps your family actually uses, since they vary widely by region.
guides.wedding-video-invitation-maker.s3: Do not rely on audio for the date, do not embed the only RSVP link inside a video that cannot be copied, and do not assume a streaming link works for guests with limited data. Always send a still image with the key details as a fallback. If you use music, choose a licensed track or a royalty-free one before sharing publicly.
guides.wedding-video-invitation-maker.q1: How long should a video invitation be?
guides.wedding-video-invitation-maker.a1: Twenty to forty-five seconds. If it covers several events, split it into short chapters rather than one long film.
guides.wedding-video-invitation-maker.a2: H.264 MP4, 1080 × 1920 vertical, small enough to play inline on a phone. Include a static image with the same details.
guides.wedding-video-invitation-maker.q3: هل ما زلنا بحاجة إلى دعوة ورقية؟
guides.wedding-video-invitation-maker.a3: بالنسبة إلى كثير من قوائم الضيوف، نعم، ولا سيما الأقارب الأكبر سنًا. أرسل الفيديو إضافةً إلى الدعوة، لا بديلًا منها، ما لم تكن متأكدًا من أن الجميع يستطيع فتحه.
